title: Reuse of consumable pipette tips for large-scale trace analysis of contaminants of emerging concern in wastewater
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00644A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Amber Vaughan, Yassir El Hadri, Juditha Gurumurthy, William Francis, Margarita White, Eric Auyang, Stephanie Wright, Leon P. Barron, Helena Rapp-Wright
This study shows that solvent-based washing enables safe pipette tip reuse for trace chemical analysis, with EtOH : H2O (50 : 50, v/v) providing the best balance of cleaning, and sustainability, reducing plastic waste without performance loss.
